content: .{@-ग, -गम@} ({@पुरोग, -गम@}) {%a.%} .²1 chief, leading, foremost, pre-eminent, <ab>oft.</ab> with the force of a noun; स किंवदन्तीं वदतां पुरोगः <ls>R. 14. 31</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 55</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 40</ls>. .²2 led or presided over by (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); इन्द्रपुरोगमा देवाः ‘the gods with Indra at the head’; अतुलाः प्रीतयो राजन् संबन्धकपुरोगमाः <ls>Rām. 7. 38. 4</ls>.
